categories.main_business_segments: Yangzhou Seashine New Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of powder metallurgy products. Its main business segments include powder metallurgy parts for electric tools, automotive components (including new energy vehicles), office and household appliance parts, and other precision metal components. The company also develops metal injection molding (MIM) products, soft magnetic composite (SMC) materials, and precision gears and actuators for various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company primarily uses powder metallurgy technology, including pressing and sintering methods, metal injection molding (MIM), and soft magnetic composite (SMC) technology. It emphasizes near-net-shape forming, high material utilization, and environmentally friendly processes. Advanced sintering, injection molding, and precision machining are key production methods, supported by proprietary patents and continuous R&D in forming complex structures and high-density materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading international electric tool manufacturers, automotive companies (including new energy vehicle makers), household appliance producers, and office equipment manufacturers. The company has deep partnerships with global electric tool giants such as Stanley Black & Decker, Bosch, Makita, and TTI. Its products serve markets in electric tools, automotive parts, home appliances, office equipment, engineering machinery, and emerging sectors like robotics and new energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a significant portion of revenue (over 60%) generated from overseas markets. Its main domestic operations are concentrated in the Yangzhou region, Jiangsu Province. It is expanding its global footprint with new subsidiaries planned in Singapore and Vietnam. The company serves international customers and participates actively in global supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yangzhou Seashine New Materials operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-precision powder metallurgy components. It procures raw materials like metal powders and molds, performs core forming and sintering processes, and supplies finished parts to downstream manufacturers in electric tools, automotive, and other industries. It outsources non-core machining processes to local subcontractors to optimize costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in powder metallurgy, MIM, and SMC technologies, aiming to develop high-strength, high-precision, and lightweight components. R&D focuses include direct forming of complex structures, enhanced sintering techniques, and new product lines for electric tools, new energy vehicles, and smart appliances. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate technology transfer and expand into new application fields such as robotics and medical devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized powder metallurgy components and assemblies to industrial customers. The company operates on a B2B model, fulfilling large volume orders based on customer specifications. It also earns income from investment returns on financial products and government subsidies, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yangzhou Seashine New Materials is a leading player in China's powder metallurgy industry, ranked among the top companies domestically. It competes with both domestic and international powder metallurgy firms, including global companies like METALDYNE, GKN, and Sumitomo. The company leverages cost advantages, advanced technology, and strong customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge, especially in the mid-to-high-end market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 297.4 million, a 32.29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 71.2 million, up 54.24%. It has shown consistent growth in revenue, profit, and cash flow, supported by expanding production capacity and new product development. Total assets reached about RMB 930 million with steady growth in net assets and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision-engineered powder metallurgy components with superior material utilization and environmental benefits. Its differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing technologies, rapid response to customer needs, and deep integration with leading global electric tool and automotive manufacturers. It offers customized, high-performance solutions that reduce costs and improve product reliability, positioning itself as a trusted partner in high-end powder metallurgy applications.
